column4: أنت تعرف يا سيدي، أن حواسي، تميل إلى جهالة، هذا العالم.
column12: You know O my Master, that my senses, lean towards the ignorance, of this world.

column12: + Woe to me if You, consider my trespasses, for weak spirit, is greatly disgraced.

column12: + O Lord remit, the trespasses, of my nature, and the weakness of my flesh.

column12: Incline Your ear, speedily to my weakness, as You have heard, the prayer of the publican.
